name: Baltimore Oriole
facts: Call pattern: a short series of rich, clear whistles, a little different for every male.
Habitat: tall leafy trees along rivers, parks and streets. The female weaves a hanging pouch nest from plant fibers.
Migration: long-distance. Winters mainly from Mexico to northern South America and returns to the Midwest around early May.
